## Checklist

- [ ] `just ci` passes locally — see
      [`docs/tooling.md`](../docs/tooling.md) for what it runs.
- [ ] If this changes what flint actually does, docs are updated in the
      same PR: [`docs/features.md`](../docs/features.md),
      [`docs/flint-file-format.md`](../docs/flint-file-format.md), and/or
      [`docs/usage.md`](../docs/usage.md), whichever apply.
- [ ] [`CHANGELOG.md`](../CHANGELOG.md) has a bullet under `[Unreleased]`
      for any behavior change.
- [ ] New behavior has both a unit test (in the relevant `src/` module)
      and an end-to-end test (`e2e/tests/*.robot`), where applicable.

See [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the full contribution
workflow.
